User Story Number: US-001
User Story Summary: Patients receive consolidated communications for sequential same-day appointments
User Story Description:
As a patient with multiple sequential appointments on the same day, I want to receive a single, consolidated text message and communication stream so that I have a clear understanding of my entire visit and don't miss any appointments or steps.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a patient has two or more sequential appointments scheduled for the same day (e.g., Ultrasound followed by Provider Visit
When automated pre-visit communications are triggered (e.g., appointment reminders, intake forms
Then the patient receives a single text message or notification that consolidates information for all sequential appointments
And the consolidated message clearly indicates that there are multiple appointments scheduled for the day
And the message includes the start time, location,
and type of all sequential appointments
And the message provides all necessary information for completing requirements for the entire day
But the EMR continues to manage these as separate appointments for clinical operational purposes

---

User Story Number: US-002
User Story Summary: Patients complete a single, unified intake process for all sequential same-day appointments
User Story Description:
As a patient with multiple sequential appointments on the same day, I want to complete a single, comprehensive intake form for my entire visit so that I don't have to fill out redundant information multiple times and can save time.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a patient has two or more sequential appointments scheduled for the same day
When the patient accesses the intake forms via the consolidated communication link
Then they are presented with a single intake workflow that covers all required information for all sequential appointments
And the system intelligently consolidates common intake questions (e.g., demographics, medical history, insurance) across all sequential appointments to avoid repetition
And upon completion, the system associates the completed intake with all relevant individual appointments in the EMR
And staff can view the unified intake data associated with the consolidated visit on the Yosi dashboard

---

User Story Number: US-003
User Story Summary: Patients can manage consolidated sequential same-day appointments with a single action
User Story Description:
As a patient with multiple sequential appointments on the same day, I want to be able to confirm, reschedule, or cancel my entire consolidated visit with a single action so that managing my appointments is simple and efficient.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a patient has multiple sequential appointments on the same day that are recognized as a consolidated visit
When the patient interacts with the appointment management system (e.g., via Yosi landing page or communication link
Then they are presented with an option to manage the entire consolidated visit as a single entity (Confirm, Reschedule, Cancel
When the patient confirms the consolidated visit
Then all individual appointments within that consolidated visit are marked as confirmed in the EMR
When the patient requests to reschedule the consolidated visit
Then the system prompts for a new consolidated time slot that accommodates all sequential appointments
And if a new valid time slot is selected, all individual appointments are updated in the EMR accordingly
When the patient requests to cancel the consolidated visit
Then all individual appointments within that consolidated visit are canceled in the EMR
And staff are notified of the consolidated action on the Yosi dashboard

User Story Number: US-004
User Story Summary: Staff can view sequential same-day appointments as a single consolidated visit on the Yosi dashboard
User Story Description:
As a practice staff member, I want to see sequential same-day appointments for a patient grouped as a single, consolidated visit on the Yosi dashboard so that I can easily understand the patient's full schedule for the day and manage their experience more effectively.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a patient has two or more sequential appointments scheduled for the same day
When a staff member views the patient's schedule or the daily appointment list on the Yosi dashboard
Then the sequential appointments are displayed as a single, consolidated visit entry
And this consolidated visit entry includes a clear visual indicator that it contains multiple appointments (e.g., an icon or label
And staff can expand (e.g., via an accordion or click) the consolidated visit entry to view details of each individual appointment (e.g., name, status, start time, provider
And staff can clearly see the overall consolidated status of the visit (e.g., 'Intake Completed', 'Checked In'
But staff can still access individual appointment details
and statuses if needed for specific operational tasks within the EMR

---

User Story Number: US-005
User Story Summary: Patients are automatically checked in for all sequential same-day appointments
User Story Description:
As a practice staff member, I want patients with sequential same-day appointments to be automatically checked in for their entire consolidated visit once their pre-visit requirements are met so that the check-in process is streamlined and I can focus on other patient needs.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a patient has two or more sequential appointments on the same day
And the patient has completed the unified intake process for their consolidated visit
And the patient's presence is detected (e.g., via geofencing, QR code scan, or first appointment manual check-in
When the system recognizes these conditions
Then the patient is automatically checked in for all sequential appointments within their consolidated visit
And the Yosi dashboard reflects a consolidated 'Checked In' status for the entire visit
And the EMR status for each individual appointment is updated to 'Checked In' or equivalent
But staff can manually override or adjust the check-in status for individual appointments if necessary
And the system handles situations where appointments are not booked at exactly the same time, ensuring check-in applies to all sequential appointments for the day.

userStories.description: As a user, I want the flight search controls to be visually consistent and correctly aligned so that I can easily plan my trip without confusion.
userStories.acceptanceCriteria:
Given I am on the flight search page
When I view the header
and search container
Then the 'SIGNUP' button style should match other CTA buttons
And the 'Multi-City' radio button should be perfectly aligned with the other trip types
And the 'Search Flights' button color should be consistent with the application brand guidelines
userStories.summary: Standardize Search Bar UI and Interaction

userStories.acceptanceCriteria:
Given I am selecting a departure date
When I interact with the date picker
Then the date format should be displayed as 'MMM DD, YYYY' instead of 'DD/MM/YYYY'

Given I am viewing the search results
When I look at the flight departure time
Then the time should be displayed in a valid 24-hour format (e.g., 01:00) instead of '25:60'
userStories.description: As a user, I want dates and times to follow a consistent and standard format so that I can clearly understand my travel schedule.

userStories.acceptanceCriteria:
Given I am viewing the flight search results
When I review the price
and flight details
Then there should be no extra whitespace between the currency symbol
and the price amount
And all dates (like arrival date) should use the same font color
and styling as other dates on the card
And the checkbox alignment for 'Stops' in the filter sidebar should be visually consistent
userStories.description: As a user, I want the search results page to have clean, readable, and consistent formatting so that I can compare flight options effectively.
userStories.summary: Improve UI Consistency in Search Results

userStories.description: As a user, I want the application to use correct grammar and professional language so that I feel confident in the service I am using.
userStories.acceptanceCriteria:
Given I am reviewing the flight search results page
When I read the warning message regarding flight timings
Then the text should be grammatically corrected from 'Please reconfirm the flight timings with airline' to 'Please reconfirm the flight timings with the airline'

userStories.description: As a user, I want the pagination component to follow a consistent visual style so that navigation through pages is intuitive.
userStories.acceptanceCriteria:
Given I am viewing the bottom of the search results list
When I look at the pagination bar
Then all page numbers
and the 'Next' button should share the same border, background,
and hover states to maintain design consistency
